content: Meera Chauhan emailed Anita Sharma regarding the expiration of her auto insurance policy (Policy No: DC-AUTO-2024-7890) and inquired about renewal steps to avoid a coverage lapse. Anita Sharma replied, apologizing for the inconvenience, clarifying that the policy was not set to auto-renew, and providing an attached renewal quote with options for reactivating coverage.

action_items: Select a renewal or reactivation option and inform the agent
